latest.title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
latest.description: SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.

latest.title: AI FOMO driving some family offices into tech investments, survey suggests
latest.description: Investment firms of ultra-wealthy families aren't immune to FOMO.

latest.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
latest.description: The CoinDesk 80 has risen around 3% in 24 hours, more than double the CoinDesk 5, while spot bitcoin ETFs lost $681 million last week.

latest.title: UK Freezes $12M London Penthouse of Alleged Prince Group Finance Chief
latest.description: Thet Li is accused of running the finances of a scam empire tied to $14 billion in Bitcoin the U.S. has moved to seize.

latest.title: Kraken parent clears Dubai’s final hurdle for dirham trading rollout
latest.description: Payward received full market approval from Dubai’s VARA to expand its digital asset services in the UAE, building on the preliminary approval received in May.

latest.title: Trump turns to Russian diesel ahead of midterms, but analysts see little price relief
latest.description: President Donald Trump's latest effort to ease a diesel supply crunch ahead of November's midterm elections is unlikely to make a dent on prices.

latest.title: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
latest.description: Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to let institutions use the tokens as trading collateral.

latest.title: Beckham, Yao Ming attend NBA China Games in a boost to Macao's live events
latest.description: The NBA China Games brought Chinese and U.S. basketball fans to Macao, which is spending big to broaden its reputation beyond a gambling mecca.

latest.title: World Bank jobs council urges 'crisis-era' employment support measures as IMF warns of AI ‘tsunami’
latest.description: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.

latest.description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 12.

latest.title: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
latest.description: Jeonbuk Bank reportedly began offering Bitcoin-backed loans to corporate customers, with a third-party custodian holding the cryptocurrency used as collateral.

latest.title: Stellantis CEO urges incentives for carmakers who build in Europe as Chinese rivals gain ground
latest.description: Stellantis' CEO urged European regulators to create incentives for carmakers to manufacture vehicles in the region amid competition from Chinese rivals.

latest.title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
latest.description: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.

latest.title: Intel, Broadcom CEOs warn capital crunch could become AI's biggest bottleneck
latest.description: The CEOs of Intel and Broadcom warned that access to capital could emerge as a major constraint on the artificial intelligence boom.

latest.title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
latest.description: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device linked to crypto losses at CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. The company says confirmed cases are limited and its internal systems remain unaffected.

latest.title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
latest.description: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.

latest.title: AI may change the price of your Big Mac and groceries — what this means for shoppers
latest.description: As retailers turn to AI tools to streamline operations, experts warn that collecting more detailed consumer data increases the risk of personalized pricing.
